tweets.html: This is the first time in 10 years the Red Sox have scored 12 or more runs in back-to-back games since May 9-11, 2016.It's the third time in four games they have scored at least 10 runs.Bob Nightengale (@BNightengale)Ho-hum, the Boston Red Sox win another one.13-1 over the Athletics.That's 9 victories in a row, and a franchise-record 27 victories in their last 30 games.They are currently tied with the Yankees for 2nd place in the AL East after being 15 1/2 games back this year.Stunning.—  https://x.com/BNightengale/status/2085905857892741390
